reviews.text:
Mary, thank you for cutting my hair today and also for the wonderful conversation. You’re a gift to your community. Unfortunately, I can’t be there on a regular basis because I live on the southern Oregon coast, but whenever I make it that way, I will definitely go no where else.

SCO DUCKS
reviews.author: Jeffrey Fisk

reviews.text: Loved it! I was 11 minutes late and they still got me and my boy in and done with great cuts!! And it cost less than basically everywhere around me. I really enjoyed the atmosphere there too. All around just great! Pic is of my boy during his cut. If I remember I'll post a shot of after later.
reviews.author: Greg Owens

reviews.text:
The Barber Shop is the only barbershop that matters.

$15 cuts that are on par with the $30+ cuts you'd get elsewhere, & you even get a free barley pop, with your patronage. 🍺🍺🍺

Aaaaaaand if you're wondering, the products they have are top notch as well. Specifically, I'm a major fan of the Bonafide & Layrite matte stuff.

Seriously. I love this place so much, I had to design them business cards that matched their greatness. So, go in & grab a few to spread the word!
reviews.author: Nick Gaskill

reviews.text: I’ve been coming here to get my hair cut with Darren for almost 7 years now, and he has reliably given me a phenomenal haircut time after time again. He always keeps me company and the value is great ($20 for a cut). I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Lucas Castillo Delgado

reviews.text: Jim tells a lot of great stories, and gives a fast and clean haircut. Always enjoyable to have him as a barber. I've gone here 3 times repeatedly because service is prompt, prices are reasonable, and Jim is an entertaining & interesting person.
reviews.author: Bones
